macros.name: bRTVToks
macros.doc: \bRTVToks and \eRTVToks enclose a series of rtVW environments.

macros.name: eRTVToks
macros.doc: At the end of the rtVW environments, initiated by \bRTVToks, the \eRTVToks command saves the number of tokens counted, and randomizes the access to the contents of the rtVW environments, this done by \r@nVToks.

macros.name: InputUsedIDs
macros.doc: We open the file \jobname-ver\selVersion.cut when \InputUsedIDs is expanded in the preamble.

macros.name: makeInfoAWarning
macros.doc: By expanding \makeInfoAWarning we change \PackageInfo to \PackageWarning, which gives it greater visibility in the log and the log report.

macros.name: rtVWHook
macros.doc: Insert the hook \rtVWHook prior to writing the verbatim content.

macros.name: uniqueXDBChoicesOn
macros.doc: \uniqueXDBChoicesOn, which if expanded, tries to choose a random token that has not already been chosen, across versions of a multi-version eqexam document.

macros.name: useLastAsSeed
macros.doc: initializes the random number generator using the last random seed.

macros.name: useRTName
macros.doc: sets the base name (use prior to the use of \useRanTok).

macros.name: useTheseDBs
macros.doc: Inputs any files included in the comma-delimited list.

macros.name: useThisSeed
macros.doc: initializes the random number generator. Use this to reproduce the same sequence of pseudo-random numbers from an earlier run.

macros.name: viewDB
macros.doc: Typeset the entire contents of a DB Test file.
